svg.title: Agent Teams / RAG Database Graph — 設計草案
svg.desc: 獨立 agent_teams_rag 資料庫草案，9 張資料表、88 個欄位。專案與文件透過 knowledge_base_documents 多對多共用，尚未套用 migration。箭頭由參照表指向被參照表。
svg.text: agent_teams_rag · 9 tables · 88 columns · Draft v4 · 設計草案，尚未 migrate
PK 主鍵 · FK 外鍵 · UQ 唯一約束 · NN 必填 · NULL 可空 · 複合約束請點選資料表查看
實線：草案中的資料庫 FK，箭頭由參照端 → 被參照端。project_name 僅邏輯對應業務系統，無跨庫 FK。
knowledge_bases 1:N knowledge_base_documents N:1 documents · 共用原文與相容索引，每份文件完成後獨立啟用

path.title: knowledge_base_documents.(knowledge_base_id) → knowledge_bases.(id) [草案 FK, ON DELETE RESTRICT]
jobs.(knowledge_base_id) → knowledge_bases.(id) [草案 FK, ON DELETE RESTRICT]
failed_jobs.(knowledge_base_id) → knowledge_bases.(id) [草案 FK, ON DELETE RESTRICT]
knowledge_base_documents.(document_id) → documents.(id) [草案 FK, ON DELETE RESTRICT]
knowledge_base_documents.(document_id, active_document_index_id) → document_indexes.(document_id, id) [草案 FK, ON DELETE RESTRICT]
document_revisions.(document_id) → documents.(id) [草案 FK, ON DELETE RESTRICT]
document_indexes.(document_id, revision_id) → document_revisions.(document_id, id) [草案 FK, ON DELETE RESTRICT]
chunks.(document_index_id) → document_indexes.(id) [草案 FK, ON DELETE RESTRICT]
document_relations.(source_index_id) → document_indexes.(id) [草案 FK, ON DELETE RESTRICT]
document_relations.(target_document_id) → documents.(id) [草案 FK, ON DELETE RESTRICT]
jobs.(knowledge_base_id, document_id) → knowledge_base_documents.(knowledge_base_id, document_id) [草案 FK, ON DELETE RESTRICT]
jobs.(document_id, document_index_id) → document_indexes.(document_id, id) [草案 FK, ON DELETE RESTRICT]
jobs.(knowledge_base_id, document_id, document_index_id, retry_of_failed_job_id) → failed_jobs.(knowledge_base_id, document_id, document_index_id, id) [草案 FK, ON DELETE RESTRICT]
failed_jobs.(document_id, document_index_id) → document_indexes.(document_id, id) [草案 FK, ON DELETE RESTRICT]
